about: The ONLYOFFICE Docs release this app takes its editor files from. scripts/upstream-watch.mjs compares it with the newest one every week; change it only together with the bundle built from it.

x2t.about: The converter, x2t, built to WebAssembly by this project from ONLYOFFICE core at the editor files' tag (source_tag): scripts/x2t/build.sh builds it in docker from what "build" names - the toolchain by its digest and one day's Ubuntu snapshot, every source by its commit - and checks the page's two files, and with --server the server build (x2t-server.wasm, docs/SERVER.md), against "files"; two builds give the same bytes. scripts/fetch-x2t.mjs downloads the zip a release attaches (url, sha512: pinned by the release that attaches it, made by fetch-x2t.mjs --pack in the pinned Node image; releases 0.2.0 to 0.3.1 attach v9.4.0.129+2, release 0.1.1 attached v9.4.0.129+1) or takes a build made elsewhere, and checks it the same way. Change it only together with a build that gives the new sums.
x2t.from: ONLYOFFICE core v9.4.0.129 (AGPL-3.0), with CryptPad's changes for WebAssembly (github.com/cryptpad/onlyoffice-x2t-wasm, AGPL-3.0-or-later) ported to it and this project's own, all in scripts/x2t/patches/, and ICU 68.2's conversion tables (scripts/x2t/icu-data.py); built the way CryptPad builds its own (emscripten, one qmake project at a time). Release 0.1.0 carried CryptPad's build, v9.3.2+3.

recipe.about: Where scripts/x2t comes from: CryptPad's Dockerfile and embuild.sh at the release commit, and its changes to ONLYOFFICE core (its core/ at the changes commit, against core v9.3.0.140, the commit that core/ was pulled from), ported to source_tag in scripts/x2t/patches/01-cryptpad-wasm.patch.

engine.about: The office engine a release attaches as engine.zip, which filex runs on the server (its engines.office; docs/SERVER.md): scripts/pack-engine.mjs writes it from x2t-server.wasm (pinned under x2t), layout-host.wasm (server/layout/host/build.sh, quickjs-ng and wasi-sdk by their sums), server/layout/worker.js and two scripts of the Document Server image pinned above, copied out unchanged by scripts/engine-ds-files.sh. Change it only together with the files that give the new sums; the zip's own SHA-256 goes into filex-app.json.
